newsitem.title: USA: Pacificorp completes tender offer for TPC.
newsitem.headline: Pacificorp completes tender offer for TPC.

text.p: PacifiCorp Holdings, Inc., a subsidiary of PacifiCorp, said Tuesday it completed its cash tender offer of $13.41 a share, or about $288 million, for TPC Corp.
TPC is a natural gas gathering, processing, storage and marketing company based in Houston. It had revenues of $617 million in 1996.
PacifiCorp announced the proposed acquisition on March 12, and commenced the cash tender offer on March 18.
"This acquisition represents a key element in PacifiCorp's strategy to become a full service energy provider," said Fred Buckman, PacifiCorp president and chief executive officer.
PacifiCorp, based in Portland, Ore., serves 1.4 million retail customers in the west and 550,000 retail customers in Australia.
TPC's stock was unchanged at $13.25, while PacifiCorp edged down 12.5 cents to $20.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
